game_title: Off By One Fixer – Bramble Maze Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze, a maze of brambles: the druid must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze: a maze of brambles
core_gameplay_loop: In Bramble Maze, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the druid ahead. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the root gate by solving code steps involving fixes that move the druid forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the root gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Off By One Fixer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
